title: Compliance Requirement Schema
description: A formal requirement an organization must demonstrably meet, issued by a regulator, professional body or standards body, and made up of one or more clause-level obligations from the semantic library. Compliance requirements are the unit of audit: each traces to the obligations it comprises, the internal policies that address it, and the statements of compliance that evidence it. The issuing body is an External Organization record, so any regulator in any jurisdiction can be represented.

complianceRequirementID.description: Unique identifier for the requirement, e.g. CREQ-VALMIN-3.1

title.description: Short, descriptive name of the requirement

source.description: The external document and section the requirement comes from

instrument.description: The code, standard or instrument, e.g. VALMIN Code 2015

regulatoryBodyExternalOrgID.description: External Organization record for the body that issued or enforces the requirement

regulatoryBodyTitle.description: Name of the body in regulatoryBodyExternalOrgID, for readability

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction in which the requirement applies

validityPeriod.description: When the requirement is in effect. Omit endDate when it has no set end

endDate.description: Date the requirement ceases to apply

obligationIDs.description: Clause-level obligations (semantic library) that make up the requirement

implementingPolicyIDs.description: Internal policies (Policy domain) that address the requirement

statementOfComplianceIDs.description: Statements of compliance that evidence the requirement has been met

mandatoryDisclosureIDs.description: Disclosures (Public Reporting domain) that the requirement calls for

orgUnitTitle.description: Organization unit accountable for meeting the requirement

orgUnitID.description: ID of the organization unit named in orgUnitTitle

reviewFrequency.description: How often the requirement and its evidence are reviewed

examples.title: Mandatory Competent Person statement
examples.description: A public report must be based on, and fairly reflect, the work of a Competent Person.
examples.regulatoryBodyTitle: The Australasian Institute of Mining and Metallurgy
